scenario.topic: Pick the tournament format for the tennis club championship

options.name: Single Elimination Tournament
options.upside: Quickly determines a winner with minimal matches.
options.concern: Each player is eliminated after one loss, limiting playtime.

options.name: Double Elimination Tournament
options.upside: Allows players a second chance after one loss.
options.concern: Takes longer to complete than single elimination.

options.name: Round Robin Tournament
options.upside: All players compete against each other for fairness.
options.concern: Requires more matches and time to complete.

options.name: Group Stage + Final
options.upside: Combines group play with a final match for excitement.
options.concern: Some players may play fewer matches depending on group results.

shared_context: The tennis club championship will be decided by four participants. The group must select a tournament format that fits four players and allows fair competition within a reasonable timeframe.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a competitive player who values efficiency and clear outcomes.
personas.private_goal: To finish the tournament quickly while ensuring a decisive winner.

A.reason_for: Quickly determines a winner with minimal matches, fitting my preference for efficiency.

B.reason_for: Allows a second chance, which feels fairer than single elimination.
B.reason_against: Takes longer to complete, which is less efficient.

C.reason_for: Fair since all players compete against each other.
C.reason_against: Requires more matches and time, which I find less practical.

D.reason_for: Combines group play with a final, adding excitement.
D.reason_against: Some players may play fewer matches, which feels unfair.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam prefers formats that balance fairness with some variety in matches.
personas.private_goal: To ensure everyone gets to play multiple matches but without dragging the event.

A.reason_against: Eliminates players after one loss, limiting playtime.

B.reason_for: Gives players a second chance, increasing fairness.
B.reason_against: Takes longer to finish than I prefer.

C.reason_for: Everyone plays each other, which is fair.
C.reason_against: More matches and longer duration than I want.

D.reason_for: Combines group play with a final, ensuring some variety and excitement.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe enjoys discussing details and values straightforward, quick competition.
personas.private_goal: To support a format that balances fairness with a swift conclusion.

A.reason_for: Minimal matches and quick determination of a winner.

B.reason_for: Second chance after a loss adds fairness.
B.reason_against: Longer duration and more matches than I prefer.

C.reason_for: Fair competition with all players meeting each other.
C.reason_against: Too many matches and takes too long.

D.reason_for: Group play plus final adds excitement and some fairness.
D.reason_against: Unequal number of matches for some players.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is highly competitive and values directness and quick results.
personas.private_goal: To have a clear and fast tournament with minimal fuss.

A.reason_for: Fast and straightforward, quickly producing a winner.

B.reason_for: Offers a second chance, which is fairer than single elimination.
B.reason_against: Takes longer to complete, which I dislike.

C.reason_for: Fair since everyone plays each other.
C.reason_against: Too many matches and longer duration, not efficient.

D.reason_for: Group stage and final add excitement.
D.reason_against: Unequal matches for some players, which feels unfair.
